statement: Accepted canonical motif compression supplies finite source and compressed motif objects.
assumptions: W has finite canonical motif M and accepted lower-rank M_comp
conclusion: M and M_comp are comparable canonical motifs
missing_hypothesis: global motif completeness outside accepted relation
caveat: Uses accepted relation only; does not prove every witness has compressible motif.

statement: Compressible motif has mergeable/refining payload roles under the accepted contract.
assumptions: payload-role refinement is included in the accepted motif relation
conclusion: Compressed payload carrier is proof-sketch well-defined
caveat: Proof-ready but not completed for arbitrary family-chain rows.

statement: Counterexample-status and certificate fields are invariant under replacing M by M_comp.
assumptions: status/certificate roles are congruent across the accepted motif rewrite
caveat: Central open blocker; not promoted to proved.

statement: Motif rewrite followed by normalization preserves support normal form.
conclusion: normalize(rewrite(W,M,M_comp)) is in selected normal form
caveat: Status proof may use this only conditionally.

statement: Canonicalization commutes with accepted motif compression up to selected refinement.
Recognized family-chain source form remains recognized after motif compression or routes to a named blocker.
conclusion: recognized source form is preserved or failure is named

statement: If any congruence premise fails, compression status does not silently succeed.
assumptions: accepted motif rewrite lacks payload/status/normal-form/source congruence
conclusion: failure is named blocker or deferred higher-support escape
missing_hypothesis: higher-support bound after operation proofs close
caveat: Classification only; not a full escape theorem.
